who: Real stack · local stand-ins for the WhatsApp Cloud API and the shop
title: WhatsApp customer service that knows when to hand over
sub: Order tracking and returns by tapping buttons, a person for everything else, and WhatsApp's 24-hour, template and opt-in rules built in.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · WhatsApp Cloud API · signed webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: A customer asks on WhatsApp where her order is
Two orders on her number: she picks one from a list, and gets the tracking link
Then a return, by tapping: the order, the item, the reason
Registered with the shop, free label included. No person needed
Another customer has a complaint. The bot hands it to a person and stays quiet
The team inbox: what needs a person comes first
Cleo answers from the inbox while the 24-hour window is open. Ticks show delivered and read
He opts in to updates with START. When the order ships, an approved template goes out
Every conversation, who solved it, and how
